description: Headline status for Workplan v7: report each predicted observable's current error against the 100× experimental target (σ_pred ≤ σ_exp / 100). Audit-only — reads existing witnesses, does not introduce new predictions. All CODATA values + uncertainties source from codata_constants / codata-2022-validation-masses.witness.json / cal-3-q-beta.witness.json — no floating literals.

The PREDICTION (pred_MeV) is the INDEPENDENT categorical value m_μ = m_e·Vol(4_1)/ℏ_q² from the Borromean witness — post the 2026-05-29 q₀ re-pin it is a genuine 9.5σ PREDICTION, NOT ratio-derived. The ~210 ppb pred-vs-codata gap (963.6× the 100× target) is the real μ-p tension; m_μ does NOT meet L2. Do not read 'ratio-derived' as 'm_μ trivially meets' (the error PR #1556 made).

two_term_qed_diagnostics.note: Diagnostic only — primary m_mu score remains pinned to the 1-term proton anchor (+209.8 ppb). Because d(m_p^QCD/m_e)/dq > 0 while d(m_mu/m_e)/dq < 0 at q0, subtracting a repulsive M_p^QED > 0 from m_p^exp lowers m_p^QCD(q_new) and decreases q_new by -2.23e-7, shifting m_mu(q_new) toward CODATA.

rows.source_witness: Q_N2 from qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json (deepest DERIVED-tier rung). c_2 = -1 PROVED via qou:QOU.BraidKnot.q_beta_categorical_precision_ladder + Kashiwara N2_factor. Higher c_k are tier='cal-anchored' (extracted from CODATA Q_β, circular, q₀-dependent) — cached for downstream reuse but NOT credited as a prediction. See deep audit docs/audits/2026-05-30-qbeta-ck-mp-dk-deep-audit.md and qbeta-scaling-bridge-investigation.witness.json. 🟧 SCORED ON THE RULED BASE, ZERO c_k RUNGS. The owner ruled 2026-09-08 that eps in Q_beta = |eps(Delta)|*E0 is the Markov trace at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) (convention D, the two-row truncation -- D7), and authorised this re-score 2026-09-12 with the price measured first (qbeta/qbeta-zd-rescore-price.witness.json). This row is now |tr_M(Delta_S)(z_D)|*E0 evaluated from q0 alone -- no CODATA in the value -- and calibrated against qbeta-published-form-is-the-inadmissible-z1.witness.json (recorded cell -17.495929%). 🛑 IT IS A BASE: no c_k ladder has been derived on an admissible base (qou-cds1, blocked on the phase qou-pdix), so do NOT read this as convention D's accuracy. WHAT IT REPLACED, for comparison only: the laddered value on the RETIRED z = 1 cell was 0.782334410278 MeV (err 0.16776% base, ~1279 ppb after five rungs) -- z = 1 is the coordinate sum and is provably NOT an admissible root under D (roots: q, q**3/(q**2 + 1); ConventionDAdmissibleRoots.lean, sorry-free). On the retired base the ladder bought ~4.5 orders, so a z_D ladder could move this row a long way; a SECOND re-score is authorised once qou-pdix closes (bean qou-iagg). The ruled cell is also 3.4609x farther from CODATA than the augmentation (z = q), which is admissible but is the finer one-row truncation and is NOT convention D -- recorded because a referee will notice, not as an argument: ranking cells by residual is the selection-against-the-target the anti-fit directive forbids. 🛑 AND THE ELEMENT IS RULED IN 6 OF ITS 11 LETTERS, NOT IN ALL OF THEM: this row scores Delta = nuc11_interleaved (gamma-gamma-selected nucleon word), selected over nuc11 gen-grouped by the gamma-gamma word-selection ruling (qou-ales). But that word is ELEVEN letters and every gamma-gamma word has EVEN length (gammaGamma_length_even, sorry-free), so the ruling reaches only the 6-letter core and provably cannot reach the 3-letter quark block (odd) or the 2-letter gluon pair (both letters positive). 5 of 11 letters are still census-derived, which is what qou-ales asks not to use. The corpus carries FOUR candidate Delta, all undershooting at z_D (order-zero E_0) -- delta_S -43.157%, nuc9 -30.936%, nuc11 interleaved -17.496% (this row, -16.678% on the canonical tower E_0), nuc11 gen-grouped -15.451%. So the figure is scoped TWICE: no ladder, and 5 element letters with no derived constraint (qou-99qc (the Delta/eps fork, open); PR #7212 narrows the nucleon-word branch).

rows.note: CONDITIONAL on three unproved classes (ArchimedeanLimit, BlochSuslinUniqueness, BringZeroModeBlochClass) — a conditional prediction, not a proved derivation. The Schwinger factor is NOT FITTED and this is measured, not asserted: parametrising it as (1 - c*h^2*alpha), the c that hits CODATA exactly is 0.7312340272 and the 1-sigma window is [0.61846303, 0.84400502], so the published c = 1 lies OUTSIDE it, at 2.383 sigma -- a fitter would have taken 0.731. But it is NOT DERIVED either: the exact vertex-moment check (docs/audits/2026-07-14-alpha-em-phase3-schwinger-coefficient-exact-check.md) gives +0.1281 against the claimed -h^2 = -0.0437, wrong order and wrong sign, ratio -2.93, and recommends the tier 'structurally-motivated / empirically-anchored'. That is the honest label. Second-best scoreable row: 238x, against 970x (m_mu) and 152-177x (the Q_beta trio). NOTE the residual's SIGN depends on the CODATA edition (the 2018->2022 shift is 2.2x the residual); the reference is read from the registry so the edition is not a choice.

convention_frame_qbeta.cache_note: Convention C (z = sqrt(q)/(1+q)), reached only via --historical-convention-C. C was excised by owner ruling (2026-08-09, re-affirmed 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-26); this artifact is retained because 10 consumers read it, including the L2 dashboard per_observable_100x_status.py. The DEFAULT (convention D) path REFUSES: no D-frame ladder has been derived, so there is no D-frame c_k to emit (bean qou-cds1). Substituting z_D into alpha = (z-1)h/2 is proved invalid by QOU.QBeta.decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero and QOU.QBeta.eigenphase_bar_defect_of_fullBar.
convention_frame_qbeta.induced_error_unquantifiable_reason: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under convention D ('convention D has no derived c_k ladder'), so no D-frame counterpart of this prediction exists to difference against.
convention_frame_qbeta.scored_rows_note: The Q_beta / m_n / Delta_pn rows published here are built at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) -- the canonical convention -- on the base the owner ruled 2026-09-08, re-scored 2026-09-12. They do NOT consume this C cache, so this block records the cache's frame and is NOT a caveat on those rows. What IS open is that no c_k ladder exists on an admissible base (qou-cds1); see qbeta_ruled_base.ladder_on_admissible_base_exists.

functional_admissibility_qbeta.note: STRONGER THAN THE CONVENTION-FRAME NOTE, AND SEPARATE FROM IT. That note says the c_k LADDER is convention-C. This says the BASE the ladder sits on uses a functional convention D provably excludes: the published closed form solves to z = 1, which is not a root of the (1^3) weight numerator. The best ADMISSIBLE cell is +12.47% (the augmentation on Delta_S) against the published 0.16776%, and the RULED cell is -43.157% -- the ruled cell is the FARTHEST of the three from CODATA, which is the anti-fit directive working as designed, not a defect in the ruling. WHICH FUNCTIONAL TO ADOPT IS NO LONGER OPEN: the owner ruled 2026-09-08 that eps is the Markov trace at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) (convention D, two-row truncation, D7), and authorised the dashboard re-score on 2026-09-12 with its price measured first (qbeta/qbeta-zd-rescore-price.witness.json). The Q_beta row is scored on the ruled base from that date, so this field records the admissibility EVIDENCE rather than a live defect -- it becomes the live warning again only if the re-score's calibration against this witness fails. Do NOT relate any cell to the ~1279 ppb the retired row used to show: that was post-ladder, and no ladder has been derived on an admissible base (qou-cds1, blocked on the phase qou-pdix), so what the ruled base would become with one is UNKNOWN. Applies to the m_n and Delta_pn rows, which are derived from this value -- and unlike the convention note, it is written ONTO those rows rather than cross-referenced from this one.
